headline: 3 Air Force personnel killed in crash at Dhaka airport's Third Terminal
summary: A pickup truck lost control and plunged from a flyover on the second floor of the terminal, leaving three dead and four others injured.
details: Three members of the Bangladesh Air Force were killed after their pickup truck lost control and plunged from a flyover on the second floor of the Third Terminal at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport.
The accident occurred around 10:20 PM on Monday, August 31, while the personnel were performing their regular duties.
The Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) confirmed the deaths of Warrant Officer Mahmud, Corporal Piyas, and LAC Jubaidul.
Four other Air Force members were injured in the crash and have been transported to the Combined Military Hospital (CMH) in Dhaka for treatment.
The victims and the injured were immediately shifted to CMH following the accident for necessary medical care and subsequent procedures.
caption:
Three Bangladesh Air Force members killed after their vehicle plunged from a flyover at Dhaka airport's Third Terminal.

Three members of the Bangladesh Air Force were killed after their pickup truck lost control and plunged from a flyover on the second floor of the Third Terminal at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport.

The accident occurred around 10:20 PM on Monday, August 31, while the personnel were performing their regular duties.

The Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) confirmed the deaths of Warrant Officer Mahmud, Corporal Piyas, and LAC Jubaidul.

Four other Air Force members were injured in the crash and have been transported to the Combined Military Hospital (CMH) in Dhaka for treatment.

The victims and the injured were immediately shifted to CMH following the accident for necessary medical care and subsequent procedures.

headline_marked: End of an era: [[Lionel Messi retires from Argentina national team]]
headline: End of an era: Lionel Messi retires from Argentina national team
summary: After 20 years of service, the football legend announces his farewell in a deeply personal handwritten letter, reflecting on a journey of triumph and heartbreak.
details: Lionel Messi has announced his retirement from the Argentina national team after two decades of representing his country. In a personal message, he stated, "I gave and delivered everything... I emptied myself, I have nothing left."
The farewell was shared via a handwritten letter spread across three pages of a simple notepad, featuring visible corrections and crossed-out words, making the message feel raw and personal.
A striking detail in the photos was a golden Harry Potter 'Time-Turner' pen used to write the letter, symbolizing the reflection on a career that spanned generations of players and coaches.
Messi's international journey was marked by early disappointments and years of criticism, but it culminated in major victories, including the 2021 Copa América and the 2022 World Cup title in Qatar.
The announcement comes after Argentina reached the 2026 World Cup final in East Rutherford, New Jersey, where they faced Spain, marking the final chapter of his international career.
The retirement message was accompanied by a video showcasing the defining moments of his career, from his early steps with the national team to the ultimate triumph as a world champion.
caption:
“I emptied myself, I have nothing left.” After 20 years, Lionel Messi says goodbye to the Argentina shirt.

Lionel Messi has announced his retirement from the Argentina national team after two decades of representing his country. In a personal message, he stated, "I gave and delivered everything... I emptied myself, I have nothing left."

The farewell was shared via a handwritten letter spread across three pages of a simple notepad, featuring visible corrections and crossed-out words, making the message feel raw and personal.

A striking detail in the photos was a golden Harry Potter 'Time-Turner' pen used to write the letter, symbolizing the reflection on a career that spanned generations of players and coaches.

Messi's international journey was marked by early disappointments and years of criticism, but it culminated in major victories, including the 2021 Copa América and the 2022 World Cup title in Qatar.

The announcement comes after Argentina reached the 2026 World Cup final in East Rutherford, New Jersey, where they faced Spain, marking the final chapter of his international career.

The retirement message was accompanied by a video showcasing the defining moments of his career, from his early steps with the national team to the ultimate triumph as a world champion.
